evidence.moatdecay: opm 5年連続改善(12.8→14.5%)+『maintain and grow market share』(会社目標として明記)→構造的減衰なし=no。ただしブランド格上げ(quality of sales)戦略による意図的な卸/数量縮小が進行中
evidence.erosion: 『Any increased competition, or our failure to adequately address any of these competitive factors, could result in reduced market share or sales』+『our industry is subject to significant pricing pressure caused by ... inflationary pressures, intense competition and a highly promotional retail environment』→競争/価格圧力は常在=emerging(現時点は格上げで管理・営利率上昇中)
